pullCleanup.stopped: The temporary CPU from this pull has stopped.

colabNb.pullCopyPolicy: Identical files are reused; same-name files with different content are saved as separate copies. Up to {{total}} notebooks are shown.

pullDisposition.renamed: Same name, different contents. Saved as a separate copy; the original was not changed.
pullDisposition.reused: Contents matched an existing project file. No new copy was needed.

colabNb.pullFailed: Could not read notebooks from this source.
colabNb.pullFileFailed: Could not save this notebook. Try again.
colabNb.pullFinishCurrent: Finish or cancel this pull before choosing a different source.
colabNb.pullInterrupted: The pull was interrupted. Files already saved were kept.
colabNb.pullKernelUnchanged: Pulling notebooks copies files to the project without switching or stopping your execution kernel.
colabNb.pullProjectChanged: The active project changed. This pull belongs to the original project and cannot write into the new one.
colabNb.pullReadingHint: You can keep editing your notebook while this page reads the selected source.
